title: Il sale nell’acqua, prima della farina
target: Metodo e fonti · Il sale nella Napoletana STG
caption_it: Nel procedimento della Napoletana STG il sale si scioglie nell’acqua prima di aggiungere la farina. La scena mostra l’aggiunta del sale, senza indicare una dose.
limits: La foto reale di Elena Davis mostra un piattino di sale tenuto sopra una ciotola d’acqua prima della farina. Si cambia l’angolo e si inclina il piattino per rendere leggibile l’aggiunta; nessuna quantità o intera ricetta trasferita dalla fonte. La sequenza descritta dalla nota resta fondata sul disciplinare STG già citato nell’app. Una foto di La Cucina Italiana è scartata: la didascalia parla del sale ma la foto mostra già un impasto con farina.

sources.author: Elena Davis / Cucina by Elena
sources.role: actual salt dish held over clear water in a glass bowl, before flour

scene: ONE simple clear glass mixing bowl with a modest level of clear water, elevated three-quarter view. The complete bowl is visible, a clear elliptical rim, curved wall and flat supported base. ONE ordinary hand comes from upper left holding a small plain shallow ivory pinch dish with terracotta edge above the water. Base this physical hand-to-dish grip on photo2. Tilt the dish slightly toward the centre of the bowl: a SMALL amount of salt is being added to the water, shown by about eight tiny SEPARATE irregular ivory dry salt flecks between the dish lip and water surface. Each is a little distinct grain, not a continuous line, liquid drip, thick white ribbon or noodle. The remaining salt still sits in the dish. No dense spray of dots. The remaining salt in the dish is one smooth low ivory mound with at most one broad contour, never photographed crystals or gritty powder. Water remains transparent and nearly clear, not a white batter or starter, no flour clumps, yeast bubbles, oil droplets, foam or steaming. A few calm broad water ripple lines where salt falls, not an explosive splash. The back glass rim stays behind the hand; the hand does not enter the water. No second hand, spoon, flour bag, yeast, scales, readings, worktop or other ingredients. Glass wall lightly ivory-tinted, no glossy plastic reflections or dramatic gradients. Do not include the source table, salt-dish ceramic pattern, background bowls or personal jewellery.

title: Misurare una teglia rettangolare
target: Metodo e fonti / Glossario · Thickness factor
caption_it: Per la teglia rettangolare servono le due misure interne: lato lungo e lato corto, senza includere il bordo esterno. Qui è mostrata la misura del lato lungo.
limits: La fotografia di Janice Lawandi documenta una teglia quadrata e una riga appoggiata sopra l’apertura. Si ricompone una teglia rettangolare generica poco profonda e si ruota la misura sul lato lungo; non si copiano marchio, letture o dimensioni. Una sola misura è mostrata; la didascalia richiede entrambe per la superficie rettangolare.

sources.author: Janice Lawandi / The Bake School
sources.role: real pan-rim/ruler support and inside-edge measuring relationship; source is square

scene: ONE empty generic shallow RECTANGULAR metal pizza baking pan, roughly four-to-three length-to-width shape with rounded small corners, straight nearly vertical inner walls and a low rolled rim. Smooth matte warm-grey metal, no handles, no engraved name, no speckled coating. View almost from above with enough tilt to see the front inner wall. Its LONG side runs left to right. ONE straight translucent ivory-tinted ruler lies horizontally across the centre of the opening, PARALLEL to the pan long edges, NOT diagonal and NOT upright measuring depth. The ruler is physically supported by the two opposite short side rims, just like the actual rim support in photo2, but the pan shape is changed from square to rectangular. The scale’s first longer tick aligns with the LEFT INNER edge at the top opening; the ruler continues past the right inner edge and ends a little beyond the outer rim. The ticks are simple sparse brown perpendicular marks along only one long edge, with a longer tick alternating with a shorter one. NO numbers or symbols, no units, no second scale, no imaginary measured value and no text. Make the inner-edge contact points clearly readable through the lightly translucent ruler. Show only this single ruler and pan, no second perpendicular ruler, arrows, dimension lines, hands, food, dough, oil, grid, patterned counter or oven. Entire pan and entire ruler within frame, with clear alpha margin all around. Thin brown outlines and restrained broad smooth washes, no shiny silver mirror.

title: Misurare il diametro interno
target: Metodo e fonti / Glossario · Thickness factor
caption_it: Per una teglia tonda misura il diametro interno passando per il centro. Il bordo esterno non fa parte della superficie utile; la riga non mostra un valore da copiare.
limits: Riferimento reale di Janice Lawandi: riga lungo il diametro di una teglia tonda. Si semplificano teglia e riga, eliminando marchi, doppia scala e numeri; la teglia generica ha pareti dritte e bordo basso. Nessun diametro prescritto o calcolo dell’area incorporato nel raster.
